tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Returns the transcript text for each video plus its language, whether the captions were auto-generated, word count, title and channel. Comma-separate up to 50 video URLs or ids. Videos with no captions come back with a status instead of text.

tools.name: youtube_channel_transcripts
tools.description: Enumerates the newest videos of a channel, @handle or playlist and returns each video's metadata and transcript in a single call. Pass "search: your query" instead of a channel to go straight from a question to transcripts without knowing which creator to ask - the top results come back with full tr

tools.name: google_trends
tools.description: For up to five keywords: relative search interest over a timeframe, interest broken down by region, and the top and rising related queries. No browser, straight from the Trends endpoints.

tools.name: google_play_reviews
tools.description: Rating, text, author, thumbs-up count, app version and the developer's reply for any Google Play app.
